NUMBER  DEFS    5,0
PRINTHL PUSH    HL
        PUSH    DE
        LD      A,H
        SRL     A
        SRL     A
        SRL     A
        SRL     A
        CALL    TRANS
        LD      (NUMBER),A
        LD      A,H
        AND     #0F
        CALL    TRANS
        LD      (NUMBER+1),A
        LD      A,L
        SRL     A
        SRL     A
        SRL     A
        SRL     A
        CALL    TRANS
        LD      (NUMBER+2),A
        LD      A,L
        AND     #0F
        CALL    TRANS
        LD      (NUMBER+3),A
        LD      DE,#5040
        LD      HL,NUMBER
        CALL    PTEXT1
        POP     DE
        POP     HL
        RET
TRANS   ADD     A,48
        CP      58
        RET     C
        ADD     A,7
        RET
